title: Web Design: GetParkin
pitch: A mobile-first parking app UI designed in Figma and built out in CSS for a client contract.
description: A mobile-first frontend design for a parking assistant app, created under contract with MindIT. I designed the full flow in Figma and then implemented it with CSS, focused on a clean, approachable mobile UX for a genuinely practical everyday problem.
